name: vscode-emulator-run
description: Thin client: connects to a remote gateway server that owns the Flutter SDK, adb, xcodebuild and the devices. F5 in an empty workspace prompts you to pick a remote project + device, tells the remote to run `flutter run`, and opens a streaming window locally. The developer machine never needs Flutter, adb, Xcode, or Android SDK.

commands.title: Emulator Stream: Run on remote device

emulatorStreamRun.server.description: WebSocket URL of the remote gateway server. This is the ONLY host address the extension needs — everything else (Flutter SDK, adb, xcodebuild, the devices, the projects) lives on that machine. Prefer 127.0.0.1 over localhost on the loopback: Node 18+ resolves 'localhost' to IPv6 first, which fails against IPv4-only servers.

emulatorStreamRun.projectPath.description: Absolute path on the REMOTE machine to a Flutter checkout (folder containing pubspec.yaml). When set, this extension bypasses the server's flutter-projects.json and runs that path directly. Overridden by the launch.json `projectPath` field if set. Mutually exclusive with `emulatorStreamRun.projectId`.

emulatorStreamRun.projectId.description: Pin a specific registered project id from the server's flutter-projects.json. Mutually exclusive with `emulatorStreamRun.projectPath`. Leave empty to be prompted.

emulatorStreamRun.flavor.description: Pin a specific flavor name for the pinned project. Leave empty to be prompted.

emulatorStreamRun.flutterPath.description: Advanced: which `flutter` binary the remote should use for ad-hoc projectPath runs. Leave empty for `flutter` on PATH.

emulatorStreamRun.desktopAppPath.description: Advanced: absolute path to an EmulatorDesktopApp binary to launch. Overrides the download-on-first-run resolver. Leave empty to let the extension auto-download the correct platform binary and cache it (recommended).

emulatorStreamRun.desktopAppRid.description: Advanced: force the extension to install a specific desktop-app RID (from the pinned release manifest). Leave empty for automatic detection (recommended). Useful edge cases: force osx-x64 on an Apple Silicon Mac to run under Rosetta 2, or pin a specific arch inside a container.

emulatorStreamRun.desktopAppBaseUrl.description: Advanced: override the base URL the extension downloads the EmulatorDesktopApp archive from. Leave empty to use the pinned URL that shipped with this extension version (typically the maintainer's GitHub Releases). Set this to a self-hosted mirror if your network can't reach the pinned URL.

emulatorStreamRun.autoUpdateDesktopApp.description: When true, the extension checks for newer compatible desktop-app releases in the background and downloads them into the cache. The currently-running binary is never swapped mid-run — the next launch picks up the newer version if the check succeeded. Set to false to freeze the desktop app at the version pinned in this extension.

emulatorStreamRun.openStreamWindow.description: Launch the local streaming window once the remote Flutter app reports started. Turn off to only orchestrate `flutter run` without displaying the stream.

emulatorStreamRun.stopGracePeriodMs.description: How long to wait for the remote Flutter process to exit gracefully after sending 'q' before escalating to SIGTERM.

server.description: WebSocket URL of the remote gateway server (overrides emulatorStreamRun.server).

device.description: Pin a specific remote device id. Omit for an interactive Quick Pick.

projectId.description: Pin a specific remote project id (from flutter-projects.json on the server). Omit for an interactive Quick Pick. Mutually exclusive with `projectPath`.

projectPath.description: Absolute path on the REMOTE machine to a Flutter checkout. Overrides `emulatorStreamRun.projectPath`. When set, the server does NOT need this project in flutter-projects.json — it runs the path directly. Mutually exclusive with `projectId`.

flutterPath.description: Advanced: `flutter` binary the remote should use for this run (only relevant for ad-hoc `projectPath`). Overrides `emulatorStreamRun.flutterPath`.

flavor.description: Pin a specific flavor name (from the project's flavors list on the server). Omit for an interactive Quick Pick.

flutterArgs.description: Extra CLI args appended to the remote `flutter run` (e.g. ["--dart-define=FOO=bar"]).

openStreamWindow.description: Open the local streaming window when the remote app reports started.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pick project + device
configurationSnippets.description: Prompts a remote-project, flavor and device Quick Pick, tells the server to run Flutter, opens the streaming window locally.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pin remote project + flavor
configurationSnippets.description: Skip the project + flavor pickers by pinning them.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: run a remote path directly
configurationSnippets.description: Bypass flutter-projects.json entirely — the server treats the given path as the project. Great when the project isn't registered on the server.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pin everything
configurationSnippets.description: Fully non-interactive — pin project, flavor and device id.
